ValidationRule.description: Ensures the Disposition is required when a case status is updated from Intake to Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Status__c , "Closed" ), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(Status__c) , "Intake" ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Disposition__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill out the Disposition when updating a case from Intake to Closed.
